privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1p: The data controller for this website is 301 Architecture Studio. For privacy requests, contact us at 301archstudio@gmail.com.
privacy.s2p: We may process identity and contact data (name, email, phone), communication data (messages and project requests), and limited technical data (IP address, browser/device information, and cookie identifiers).
privacy.s3p: We process data to respond to inquiries and provide services (pre-contractual steps or contract performance), secure and improve the website (legitimate interests), comply with legal obligations, and where required, based on consent.
privacy.s4p: Personal data may be shared with trusted service providers (such as hosting, email, analytics, and technical support) under data processing agreements. We do not sell personal data.
privacy.s5p: If data is transferred outside the EEA, we apply appropriate GDPR safeguards, including Standard Contractual Clauses and additional technical measures where needed.
privacy.s6p: Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary for the purposes above, including legal, tax, accounting, and claims defense requirements.
privacy.s7p: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, object, and request data portability. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw consent at any time.
privacy.s8p: You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority if you believe your rights under GDPR are being infringed.
privacy.s9p: For GDPR or privacy-related requests, contact us at 301archstudio@gmail.com.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.s1p: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. Under GDPR and the ePrivacy framework, non-essential cookies require your prior consent.
cookies.s2p: Strictly necessary cookies are used on the basis of legitimate interest to provide core website functionality. Analytics, preferences, and marketing cookies are used only with your consent.
cookies.s3p: We may use strictly necessary cookies, analytics cookies, functionality/preference cookies, and third-party cookies.
cookies.s4p: You can accept, reject, or customize non-essential cookies at any time through your cookie banner or preferences panel. You can also change settings in your browser.
cookies.s5p: Some cookies may be set by third-party providers (for example, embedded media or analytics tools). Their processing is governed by their own privacy notices.
cookies.s6p: Cookie lifetime varies by type. Session cookies expire when you close your browser; persistent cookies remain for a defined period unless deleted earlier.
cookies.s7p: We may update this Cookies Policy to reflect legal or operational changes. The latest version is always published on this page.
cookies.s8p: For cookie and consent-related questions, contact us at 301archstudio@gmail.com.
